# ČS Dating Wien

> ČS Dating Wien is Vienna's curated speed dating event for Slovaks and Czechs, plus a community quiz night. Edition II takes place on Monday, 12 October 2026, 19:30–21:30 at a mystery venue in Vienna (exact location announced 48 hours before to confirmed guests). 16 spots (8 men, 8 women), ages 30–45. Entry: €69. A community Quiz Night takes place earlier, on Saturday 8 August 2026, open to everyone (singles and groups of friends), no age limit, group pricing from €10. Organizer: Jakub Popluhar, M.Ed., based in Vienna.

## About

ČS Dating Wien brings together Slovak and Czech expats in Vienna for in-person, curated evenings. The speed-dating format runs several short rounds; matches are arranged privately after the event. Events are conducted in Slovak and Czech. No German or English required.

The project addresses a gap in Vienna's dating scene: Slovaks and Czechs in Vienna (tens of thousands of people) have no dedicated venue for meeting partners and friends who share their language and cultural background. Edition I (22 June 2026) was successfully completed with strong participant feedback (average rating 5.0/5).

## Upcoming Events

- [Quiz Night – 8 August 2026](https://csdating.eu/#kviz) : Czechoslovak community quiz night in Vienna. Open to all, singles and groups of friends/teams. No age limit. Group pricing: 1 person €10, 2 people €18, 3 people €25, 4 people €30. Direct purchase via Stripe. In Slovak and Czech.
- [Edition II – 12 October 2026](https://csdating.eu/) : Speed dating, 16 spots (8 men, 8 women), ages 30–45, Vienna mystery venue, €69. Application with manual review.

## Pricing

- Speed dating (Edition II): €69 standard entry. Full refund within 72 hours if the applicant does not match the criteria.
- Quiz Night: group price per team — €10 (1), €18 (2), €25 (3), €30 (4). Paid directly online; spot reserved immediately.

## Organizer

Jakub Popluhar — M.Ed., international event organizer. Has attended dozens of speed dating events in Vienna and founded ČS Dating Wien to fill the gap he personally experienced. Operations: Martina.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What language are the events in?
A: Slovak and Czech. The MC alternates both languages. No German required.

Q: Who can attend the speed dating?
A: Slovaks and Czechs living in Vienna, ages 30–45, seriously looking for a relationship.

Q: Who can attend the Quiz Night?
A: Anyone — singles and groups of friends or teams. No age limit. It is a community evening, not only dating.

Q: Is there a refund policy?
A: Speed dating: full refund within 72 hours if the application does not match criteria. Other cancellation rules: see csdating.eu/terms/.

Q: How does matching work (speed dating)?
A: After the event, attendees submit a match form. If interest is mutual, contacts are exchanged privately between the two people only.
